# routeros_ip_firewall_service_port (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
# Disable the SIP ALG (NAT helper); the entry is built into RouterOS and is
# adopted by name, never created.
resource "routeros_ip_firewall_service_port" "sip" {
  name     = "sip"
  disabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the built-in NAT helper (`ftp`, `tftp`, `irc`, `h323`, `sip`, `pptp`, `rtsp`, `udplite`, `dccp`, `sctp` on RouterOS 7.23). The entry must already exist on the device.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `ports` (String) Comma-separated list of ports the helper inspects (`5060,5061`). Helpers without a port (`h323`, `pptp`, `udplite`, `dccp`, `sctp`) leave it empty. Unset keeps the device value.
- `sip_direct_media` (Boolean) `sip` only: allow the media stream to bypass the router when both endpoints are directly reachable.
- `sip_timeout` (String) `sip` only: connection-tracking timeout for SIP sessions (`1h`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `invalid` (Boolean)

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/ip/firewall/service-port get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_ip_firewall_service_port.sip *5
#Or you can import a resource using its name
terraform import routeros_ip_firewall_service_port.sip sip
terraform import routeros_ip_firewall_service_port.sip "name=sip"
```
